titleTr: Okulda kim ne yapar? Who, which, that

explainTr: Bir kişiyi ya da şeyi tanımlamak için 'who', 'which' veya 'that' kullanırsın. Kişi için 'who' (ya da that), eşya ve yer için 'which' (ya da that): The librarian is the woman who helps students. This is the form which you must sign.

Bu kelimeler cümlede özne yerine geçiyorsa özne tekrar edilmez: The aide who helps me (who she helps me değil). Cümleciğin kendi öznesi varsa (the book that Linda gave me) 'that' ya da 'which' atılabilir.
Önce ana cümleyi, hemen ardından tanımlayan cümleciği yazarsın: The custodian who arrives early cleans the building.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede tanımlama fiilin başındaki bir sıfat-fiil ile yapılır: 'öğrencilere yardım eden kadın'. İngilizcede kişi sona gelir ve who ile bağlanır: the woman who helps students.

examples.en: The principal is the person who makes big decisions.
A cafeteria is a room that serves lunch.
examples.tr: Yemekhane öğle yemeği servis eden bir odadır.

examples.en: This is the form which every substitute must sign.
examples.tr: Bu, her vekilin imzalaması gereken formdur.

examples.en: The book that Linda gave me is great.

exercises.q: The woman ___ answers the phone is Mrs. Lee.
This is the form ___ you must sign today.
The man ___ fixes the heater works late.
exercises.whyTr: Özne yerine geçen 'that' kişi ve eşya için kullanılır.

exercises.q: A cafeteria is a room ___ serves breakfast and lunch.
exercises.whyTr: Yer ve eşya için 'that' (ya da 'which') gelir; 'who' yalnız kişi içindir.

options: The counselor who helps us is kind.
The counselor who she helps us is kind.
The counselor which helps us is kind.
The counselor helps us who is kind.
exercises.whyTr: Who zaten özne yerine geçer; arkasına ikinci bir 'she' eklenmez.

exercises.q: Where is the book ___ I left on my desk?
exercises.whyTr: Kitap bir eşya olduğu için 'which' (ya da 'that') kullanılır.

exercises.answer: The coach who teaches gym is very friendly
I need the paper that the principal signed

exercises.q: In which sentence can you leave out 'that'?
options: The woman that called is Linda.
The man that works here is Mr. Brown.
The book that Linda gave me is good.
The student that sits there is new.
exercises.whyTr: Cümlecikte kendi öznesi (Linda) varsa 'that' atılabilir; özne yerine geçiyorsa atılamaz.

exercises.q: The custodian who ___ the hallway yesterday was very kind.
The aide ___ helps in my class is very kind.
The book ___ I borrowed is due on Friday.

reading.title: Who does what at Lincoln Elementary?
reading.text:
On Monday, Hafsa goes to Lincoln Elementary School for a training day. Mr. Brown, who works in the front office, gives her a visitor badge and a list of the school staff.

"Let me explain who does what," he says. "The principal is the person who makes the big decisions. She also talks to the parents when there is a serious problem. The counselor is someone who helps students with their feelings and their plans for the future. The custodian, who arrives before everyone else, cleans the building and fixes small problems. The librarian is the person that helps students find books."

Hafsa writes everything in her notebook. Then they walk to the cafeteria, which is a large room that serves breakfast and lunch. An assistant who works with a second-grade class is helping a boy who cannot find his lunch card. Hafsa smiles and thinks, "I can do this kind of work."

Next, Mr. Brown shows her the attendance form. "This is the form that every substitute must complete in the first ten minutes," he says. "Please do not forget it. The office needs it to know which students are at school."

At the end of the day, Hafsa feels nervous but happy. That evening she tells Emre, "Now I know the people who keep the school running. They are a team that works very hard, and I want to be part of it."

questions.q: Who makes the big decisions at the school?
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'The principal is the person who makes the big decisions.'

options: He cleans the building and fixes small problems.
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'cleans the building and fixes small problems'.

questions.q: What must a substitute do in the first ten minutes?
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'every substitute must complete in the first ten minutes'.

questions.q: How does Hafsa feel at the end of the day?

listening.title: A tour of the school office

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Mr. Brown, who should I talk to if a student gets very upset?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Talk to Ms. Rivera. She is the counselor who works in room twelve.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: And who do I call if the lights stop working?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Call Mr. Davis. He is the custodian who fixes everything in this building.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Is he the man who wears the blue cap?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Yes, that's him. Now, this is the form that you must fill out every morning.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Right. Put it in the basket that is next to my desk before nine fifteen.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: What about lunch duty? Who supervises the students in the cafeteria?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: The coach and two assistants who work there. You only walk with your class.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: That sounds easy. Thank you for explaining everything.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: You're welcome. The people here are friendly, and they are always ready to help.

questions.q: Who should Hafsa talk to about an upset student?
questions.whyTr: Mr. Brown: 'Talk to Ms. Rivera. She is the counselor.'

questions.q: Who fixes things in the building?
questions.whyTr: Mr. Brown: 'Mr. Davis ... the custodian who fixes everything'.

questions.q: Where does Hafsa put the attendance form?
options: In the basket next to Mr. Brown's desk
questions.whyTr: Mr. Brown: 'the basket that is next to my desk'.
Mr. Brown: 'The coach and two assistants who work there.'

writing.promptTr: Bir arkadaşına, ziyaret ettiğin bir okuldaki 3 kişiyi 'who', 'that', 'which' ile anlatan kısa bir e-posta yaz (80-120 kelime).
writing.promptEn: Write a short email to a friend about three people you met at a school. Use who, that or which. (80-120 words)
writing.model: Hi Linda, I visited Lincoln Elementary School yesterday, and I met many interesting people. Mr. Brown is the secretary who works in the front office. He is a man who always smiles. Ms. Rivera is the counselor who helps students with their problems. Mr. Davis is the custodian that cleans the building every morning. I also saw the cafeteria, which serves hot lunch for four hundred students. It is a school that feels like a big family. I want to work there as a substitute teacher. Can we have coffee this weekend? I want to tell you everything. Hafsa
checklistTr: Kişiler için who (ya da that), eşyalar için which (ya da that) kullandın mı?
Who'dan sonra ikinci bir özne (who she) eklemedin, değil mi?
En az üç kişiyi tanıttın mı?
Cümleler büyük harfle başlıyor ve noktayla bitiyor mu?

examSet.whyTr: Bina bakım ve temizliği custodian'ın işi.

Which word is closest in meaning to 'employee'?
Which word is closest in meaning to 'supervise'?

examSet.q: Hafsa ___ in the U.S. for three years.
examSet.whyTr: 'For three years' ile Present Perfect: has lived.

examSet.q:
Ms. Lee is the librarian who works at Lincoln Elementary. She helps students who need books for projects. Today she is reading a story that a second-grader wrote.

What is Ms. Lee reading today?
options: A story written by a second-grader
examSet.whyTr: Metin: 'a story that a second-grader wrote'.

examSet.q:
Mr. Davis is the custodian who opens the school at six o'clock. He turns on the lights and checks the heater before anyone arrives. "A warm school is a happy school," he says.

Why does Mr. Davis check the heater?
examSet.whyTr: Metin: 'A warm school is a happy school.'
